paite: Huaiziak in i lau ding uh, huchi lou in zaw akhawlna a lutna thuchiam om lai napi, na lak ua kuapeuh ching lou in na om kha zenzen ding uh.
heading: Khrist Khawlna Taktak
english: Let’s fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.

paite: Amau kiang a gen ahih bang in tanchinhoih i kiang ua gen ahi ngal a; himahleh athuzak uh amaute'n aphattuampih kei uh, azate toh ginna a akizom louh ziak un.
english: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them, because it wasn’t mixed with faith by those who heard.

paite: Ei gingta khinte huai khawlna ah i lut lellel uhi, "Ka thangpaihna a ka kichiam bang in ka khawlna ah alut kei hial ding uh," achih bang in; leilung pian tung a kipan ama nnate sep zoh hita mahleh.
english: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest;” although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

paite: Koi lai mun hiam ah ni sagih ni thu hichibang in agen hi: "Huan ani sagih ni in Pathian in anasep tengteng akhawlsanta," chi in.
english: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works;”

paite: Huan hiai mun ah, "Ka khawlna ah alut kei ding uh," achi nawn hi.
english: and in this place again, “They will not enter into my rest.”

paite: Huchi in ni dang a tanchinhoih za masate thuman louh ziak in lut kei mah le uh, khenkhatte huai khawlna a alutna ding ua thuchiam a-om lai ziak a lut lai ding a-om uhi.
english: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter into it, and they to whom the good news was preached before failed to enter in because of disobedience,

paite: Hun sawttak nung in David ah ama a kigensa bang in bang ni hiam aseptuan nawn hi. "Tuni a aw na zak chiang un na lungtang uh khauhsak kei un," chi in.
english: he again defines a certain day, “today”, saying through David so long a time afterward (just as has been said), “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts.”

paite: Joshua in amaute na khawlsakta hileh zaw, huai nung in ni tuam dang thu gen angai kei ding hi.
english: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.

paite: Huchi in Pathian mite a ding in Sabbath khawlna a-om lai hi.
english: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.

paite: Pathian in ama nasepte akhawlsan bang in, akhawlna a lut khinsa mi'n leng anasepte akhawlsan samta hi.
english: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.

paite: Huchi in kuamah huai thumanlouhna bang a om a i puklouhna ding un huai khawlna a lut ding in phatuam i ngai ding uhi.
english: Let’s therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.

paite: Pathian thu ahing a, thil ahihthei a, namsau hiamtuah bangchibang sang in ahiam a, hinna leh kha, guhlawi leh guhngek tuamkhen hel khop in asun thei a, lungtang a ngaihtuah leh tupte athei pah thei hi.
english: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

paite: Huaiziak in thilsiam peuhmah ama mitmuh a lang lou himhim a-om kei; i tanchin tutna dingpa mitmuh ah bangkim vuaktang leh kihongsa ahi.
english: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.

paite: Hichi in van munte a paisuak khinsa siampu lianpen thupitak, Jesu Pathian Tapa, i neih ziak in i thugin i pomkip ding uhi.
heading: Khrist I Siampu Lianpen
english: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let’s hold tightly to our confession.

paite: Siampu Lianpen i hat louh kitheihnate hon theihpih pha lou nei i hi kei ua; eimah bang a lam tuamtuam a khemna tuaksa, khelh bel khial lou, nei i hi zaw uhi.
english: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.

paite: Huchi in zahngaihna i muhtheihna ding leh huh i poimoh chiang a huhna hehpihna i ngah theihna ding in, hehpihna laltutphah hangtak in i naih ding uhi.
english: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.
